name: map-style-round2
question: Round 1 settled that the SUBJECT enumeration is the whole lever and that the negative prompt is inert at cfg 1.0 (t3 vs t4 were pixel-identical). Round 2 asks two things. TOWN: does naming the exit count kill the spurious second road off the frame, and do larger buildings cost the connecting lane? ROUTE: map-route has never been trialled and its one draft (pt-map-r2) came out as a closed rectangle of path in a green field with no marsh at all — does the same enumeration fix carry to routes, and do the two edge exits land?
